Omit these separate hair strands. Preserve grayscale material values, metal panels, silhouette, broad proportions, eye holes, visible vents, left/right asymmetries and exact visible plate arrangement. One complete detached mask only on genuine native alpha-zero transparent background, with an opaque physical metal body and antialiased contour, occupying about72percent of canvas height and at least10percent empty alpha margin on EVERY side. This remains a candidate for human fidelity review, not a 1:1 canonical certification. IDENTITY: Eclipse, exactly image1. Lock its large round dark recessed forehead disk with bright metallic ring, the top notch/opening and the small existing radial ticks along the visible inner lower arc; do not turn it into a clock, turbine, fan or glowing reactor. Keep the tiny center bridge assembly below the disk, the slanted narrow brow/eye apertures, silver side rims with the existing circular detail on image-left temple, and two elongated framed recessed lower cheek panels flanking the slim central vertical mouth/chin piece. Keep the taper and lower jaw silhouette visible in the source. No invented hanging structures or additional crown horns.
